question: Which of the following metal is always a component in an amalgam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mercury is always a component in an amalgam because it is a liquid metal at room temperature and easily mixes with other metals to form a solid alloy.**
 
• Amalgam is a** dental filling **material that has been used for over 150 years and is made by mixing mercury with other metals such as **silver, tin, and copper.**
 
• Strontium is not** **commonly used in dental materials and is not a component of amalgam.
 
• Zinc is used in** some dental materials** but is not always a component of amalgam.
 
• **Aluminum is not used in dental amalgam due to its potential toxicity and reactivity with mercury.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Strontium is a chemical element with atomic number 38.**

 
 
• It is a **soft, silvery-white metal** that is used in some alloys and as a **radioactive tracer** in medical imaging.
 
 
 
• **Zinc is a chemical element with atomic number 30.**
 
 
• **​**It is a **bluish-white meta**l that is used in a variety of applications, including as a component in **dental materials** and as a** **dietary supplement.
 
 
 
• **Aluminum is a chemical element with atomic number 13.**
 
 
• **​**It is a lightweight**, **silvery-white** **metal that is used in a wide range of applications, including in **construction, packaging, and transportation. **
